newsitem.title: UK: Guinness unsurprised by Arnault resignation.
newsitem.headline: Guinness unsurprised by Arnault resignation.

text.p: Guinness Plc on Monday said it was not surprised by the resignation of Bernard Arnault, chairman of French luxury goods group LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton, from the board of Guinness.

"We can confirm that we have received M. Arnault's resignation this afternoon," a Guinness spokesman said. "Clearly this was not surprising since he has recently adopted a different view to the rest of the board on the future strategy of the company."
The spokesman said the Guinness board will meet for a routine meeting later this week when Arnault's resignation will be accepted. He has been a member of the board since March 1989.

Guinness announced a plan to merge with Grand Metropolitan Plc in May, sparking opposition from LVMH, which is the biggest single shareholder in both groups, owning 14.2 percent of Guinness and 6.4 percent of GrandMet.
